note: REQ-MAT-51 / REQ-FIN-58 (D.3-31): MAT motion rules at error over src/**. Each row is a finding that existed when the guard was widened, in a file another WP owns; the row is routed to that WP as a clause transfer and expires at RC-1. scripts/mat/motion-lint-l1.mjs fails on any finding without a row, on a count above its row, on a row whose count is now lower or zero (delete or lower it: the baseline only shrinks), and on any row under --enforce-zero. Never add rows.

rows.transfer: Replace the drag-frame requestAnimationFrame with src/motion's subscribeFrame (shared ticker).
Replace the 1 s retry-countdown setInterval with a timer that is not a component-owned loop (setTimeout chain or a shared ticker subscription).
Schedule the scroll-to-end frame through src/motion's ticker instead of requestAnimationFrame.
Schedule the post-expand focus/scroll frame through src/motion's ticker instead of requestAnimationFrame.
Flush resize deltas through src/motion's subscribeFrame instead of requestAnimationFrame.
Drive autoplay advance without a component-owned setInterval (gated by usePreference('allowContinuous'), via a timer or the shared ticker).
Read reduced motion via usePreference('motion') (src/theme/preferences) instead of matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').
